title: A Club for Everyone
text:
Sam is fifteen and goes to a big school in the city. Last month, he started a chess club at lunchtime. At first, only three students came to the club. Now there are twelve members, and they meet every Tuesday.

Sam's friend Ana is not very good at chess. She still joins the club because she likes the friendly atmosphere. The members help each other learn new moves, and the teacher, Mr. Brown, gives them small prizes each month.

questions.text: How many members does the chess club have now?
Why does Ana join the chess club?
options: She is very good at chess

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Sam?
options: He is friendly and wants others to enjoy chess
He wants to leave the club

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the chess club?
options: It is a welcoming place for beginners
It is only for expert players

vocabulary.definition: people who belong to a group
the feeling or mood of a place
things given to a winner or as a reward

paragraph_translations: Sam tem quinze anos e estuda em uma escola grande na cidade. No mês passado, ele começou um clube de xadrez na hora do almoço. No começo, apenas três alunos iam ao clube. Agora há doze membros, e eles se reúnem toda terça-feira.

A amiga de Sam, Ana, não é muito boa em xadrez. Ela continua no clube porque gosta do ambiente amigável. Os membros se ajudam a aprender novos movimentos, e o professor, Sr. Brown, dá pequenos prêmios todo mês.
